title: Cosmic Palm Tree Portal
description: A surreal beach scene at twilight shows a woman with long braided hair and tattoos sitting on a massive palm tree log extending over turquoise water. Opposite her, another woman in a black bodysuit levitates upside down with arms outstretched as bright beams of light and a glowing circular cosmic portal descend from a vibrant galaxy-filled sky.
prompt: Surreal tropical beach at dusk with a giant palm tree log stretching over crystal clear turquoise water. A tattooed woman in a blue bikini with long braided hair and Dominican flag elements sits on the log looking toward a woman in a black bodysuit who is levitating upside down with arms spread. A massive glowing circular portal with concentric rings floats in a vibrant starry galaxy sky, shooting beams of light down onto the floating woman, cosmic clouds, seashells and flip-flops on the sand, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene
